conventions.convention: The filtration F_t contains current context and available features before round-t noise; A_t is F_t-measurable and η_t is F_{t+1}-measurable. Post-round information is H_t = F_{t+1}. Independence between rounds is not assumed.
The ridge objective uses the unaveraged sample sum plus λ times the squared Euclidean parameter norm; V_0 = λI, b_0 = 0, and the initial estimate is zero.
Dimension and horizon are positive integers, λ > 0, L ≥ 1, and m_2 ≥ 0; every available feature has norm at most L and the deterministic true parameter has norm at most m_2.
Finite action sets are ordered and ties select the first maximizer; compact feature sets require a supplied attained measurable predictable maximizing selector.
The round-t confidence radius uses V_{t-1}, and the algorithm uses β_t = max{1, ρ_t²}.
The regret bound concerns random pseudo-regret formed from true linear means and assumes each available set has true-mean range at most one.
The expected-regret corollary takes n ≥ 2 and δ = 1/n; B_n is generally random, and the displayed constant C explicitly depends on λ, m_2, and L.
The Gaussian-mixture, confidence, and regret results explicitly assume AC and Countable Choice; conditional expectations are interpreted almost surely without a completed-filtration assumption.

load_bearing.statement: The model specifies predictable bounded features, a deterministic norm-bounded parameter, conditionally 1-sub-Gaussian reward noise, attained measurable maxima, and the unaveraged ridge estimate.

Assume AC and Countable Choice and the finite-dimensional linear contextual bandit model. With S_t = Σ_{s≤t} A_sη_s and H_t = F_{t+1}, Z_t = sqrt(det(V_0)/det(V_t)) exp(S_tᵀV_t⁻¹S_t/2), Z_0 = 1, is a nonnegative integrable supermartingale with respect to (H_t) from t = 0 to n.

Assume AC and Countable Choice and the model. For δ ∈ (0,1), the ellipsoids centered at the round-(t−1) ridge estimate with radius sqrt(λ)m_2 + sqrt(2 log(1/δ) + log(det(V_{t−1})/λ^d)) contain θ* simultaneously for every 1 ≤ t ≤ n with probability at least 1−δ.

For d,n ≥ 1, λ > 0, V_0 = λI_d, and arbitrary a_1,…,a_n ∈ R^d, define V_t = V_{t−1}+a_ta_tᵀ and u_t = a_tᵀV_{t−1}⁻¹a_t. Every V_t is positive definite, u_t ≥ 0, det V_t = det V_{t−1}(1+u_t), and Σ min{1,u_t} ≤ 2 log(det V_n/det V_0).
In the model, every V_t for 0 ≤ t ≤ n is symmetric positive definite and invertible, det V_t ≥ λ^d > 0, and xᵀV_t⁻¹x ≤ ||x||_2²/λ for every x ∈ R^d.

Assume AC. If every fixed real q satisfies the integrable conditional MGF bound E[exp(qη) | G] ≤ exp(q²/2) almost surely, then every bounded real G-measurable Q satisfies E[exp(Qη−Q²/2) | G] ≤ 1 almost surely.
For d,n ≥ 1, λ > 0, L ≥ 0, and ||a_t||_2 ≤ L, the ridge matrices have positive determinants and log(det V_n/det V_0) ≤ d log(1+nL²/(dλ)).

Under AC, Countable Choice, the model, LinUCB, and per-round true-mean range at most one, with probability at least 1−δ the pseudo-regret is at most sqrt(8nβ_n log(det V_n/det V_0)) ≤ sqrt(8dnβ_n log(1+nL²/(dλ))). The stated exact-real procedure also completes n rounds with O(nd³+d²Σ_{t∈F}m_t) operations apart from compact-selector costs.

concerns.concern: Fact F2 attributes to thm-basic-algebra-and-order-properties-of-conditional-expectation that conditional expectation 'pulls out bounded G-measurable factors'. The opened supplier's Statement and proof establish scalar linearity, order, constants, total expectation, modulus control, and strict order, but no bounded measurable pull-out rule. Step 1.1 uses the indicator case. That case follows immediately by testing the defining event integrals on intersections with B_j, so this is a citation gap rather than a false conclusion.

Fact F6 says thm-basic-algebra-and-order-properties-of-conditional-expectation 'pulls out bounded measurable factors', although the opened supplier neither states nor proves that rule. Step 2.1 uses it for W_k and indicator-times-W_k. Bounded nonnegative pull-out follows from the defining event-integral property by simple approximation and monotone convergence, but this justification or an exact supplier is missing.
